findings.title: Loading the default CA bundle now makes importing requests fail
findings.suggested_fix: Defer loading until a verified HTTPS connection is first needed, or retain any initialization error and raise it only when default certificate verification is requested.

testing_gaps: Runtime behavior was not exercised because urllib3 is not installed in the checkout environment.

residual_risks: The preloaded SSLContext is module-global and shared by Requests adapters; no code path in the diff mutates its trust roots after initialization, though direct access to private module internals could alter it.
testing_gaps: No tests were run. Inspection confirms verify=True retains CERT_REQUIRED and custom CA paths remain validated and routed to urllib3.
